quiz.question: Which Pandas structure is one-dimensional and contains labeled values?
quiz.explanation: A Series is a one-dimensional labeled array in Pandas capable of holding any data type along with an index.

quiz.question: Which method selects rows using integer positions?
quiz.explanation: .iloc[] is purely integer position-based (from 0 to length-1 of the axis), whereas .loc[] uses labels.

quiz.question: Which method identifies missing values?
quiz.explanation: isna() (and its equivalent isnull()) detects missing values across DataFrames and Series, returning boolean masks.

quiz.question: Which aggregation is generally more resistant to extreme values (outliers)?
quiz.explanation: The median is the 50th percentile and is robust against skewed values and extreme outliers, unlike the arithmetic mean.

quiz.question: Which join keeps every row from the left DataFrame?
quiz.explanation: A left join (how='left') preserves all records from the left DataFrame and populates missing right-side matches with NaN.

quiz.question: Which method combines DataFrames using matching key columns?
quiz.explanation: pd.merge() combines DataFrames based on common key columns (similar to SQL relational joins).

quiz.question: Which method is suitable for aggregation across rows and columns?
quiz.explanation: pd.pivot_table() creates multidimensional spreadsheet-style pivot summaries aggregating intersecting row and column categories.

quiz.question: What is the main benefit of reading CSV data with chunksize?
options: Avoids loading the complete dataset into memory at once
quiz.explanation: chunksize allows processing large datasets batch by batch, preventing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures when files exceed physical RAM.

quiz.question: Which operation creates binary columns from categorical features?
quiz.explanation: pd.get_dummies() converts categorical features into dummy/indicator variables (one-hot encoding) with 0 and 1 values.

quiz.question: Why should imputation statistics be learned using training data only?
options: To increase the number of features
quiz.explanation: Computing statistics on the entire dataset prior to splitting leaks target and test-set distributions into the model training pipeline.
